summary: The Phase 3 adversarial round at the audited head 3a080e490b067aeb0c41d1f23fd3122d53714794 adds 65 cases in three files, and every case passes. The K2 and path file attacks edge keys and traversal shapes against the contract and the R3 rule, and pins the 173 shipped clip entries.
